CNN's Yoko Wakatsuki contributed to this report.

Seven people were also killed Monday in a separate attack at a Luhansk government building, health officials said.

The northern lights have been particularly spectacular in 2013 as the sun is expected to reach the peak of its 11-year solar cycle later this year.
